about.body: The AJ34 is Jaguar's 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine, in production from 2002 to 2009. It was fitted to two models in the Jaguar range: the XF (X250, 2008–2009) and the XK (X150, 2006–2009). The AJ34 is part of the wider AJ-V8 engine family and represents a later, more refined version of Jaguar's V8 architecture, following the earlier AJ26/AJ27 4.0-litre units. It was offered in both naturally aspirated and supercharged forms across different models, with the naturally aspirated version found in the entry-level V8 XF and XK.

byModel.body: The XF (X250) used the AJ34 in its 4.2 V8 variant during the model's first production year (2008–2009). This was the entry-level V8 option for the XF before the introduction of the later 5.0-litre AJ133 engine. The XK (X150) also used the AJ34 in its 4.2 V8 variant (2006–2009). This was the standard V8 engine for the XK before the later 5.0-litre AJ133 unit replaced it.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ34 spans two different models — the XF and XK — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and specification, which we do by registration. An AJ34 from an XK isn't a drop-in match for an AJ34 from an XF, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
